description: This file contains implementation of max pooling operations for quantized (uint8) tensors in the QNNPACK library used within PyTorch. It includes functions for creating and setting up a max pooling operator specific to the NHWC data format, handling parameter validation, memory allocation, and configuration of internal data structures.

classes.name: struct pytorch_qnnp_operator
classes.description: Represents a max pooling operator with configuration parameters and internal buffers used in QNNPACK.
